The overview

Aruba is a sunny, arid Dutch-Caribbean island just off Venezuela, known for calm white beaches, steady trade winds and a reliably dry climate.

Top things to do in Aruba

  • Relax on Eagle and Palm Beaches
  • Explore Arikok National Park
  • Snorkel the Antilla shipwreck
  • Stroll colorful Oranjestad
  • Watch sunset at the California Lighthouse

Best time to visit

The sweet spot for Aruba is generally year-round — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Is it safe?

Check your government's latest travel advisory. Watch your belongings in crowds and tourist areas, and check your government’s current advisory before you go. Visa for US passports: Check entry requirements for US passports.

A bit of history

Inhabited by the Caquetio, claimed by Spain then the Dutch, Aruba is now an autonomous country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

Culture & language

Aruban culture is a Dutch-Caribbean-Latin blend; locals often speak Papiamento, Dutch, Spanish and English, and the island is known for its safety and hospitality.

Language: the local language · English spoken: varies
